invariants.rationale: The method returns a non-null HoodieData object wrapping the input list.
Input parameter is used as the source, so it should not be null at this point.
The returned HoodieData wraps the exact same number of WriteStatus elements as in the original records list.
Assuming records list has no null elements for HoodieData wrapping to be safe.
If records is not empty, the first element of result corresponds to the first element of records.
